question: Which of the following dancers is related to Kathakali?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kunchu Kurup.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kathakali is a classical dance form that originated in the Indian state of Kerala.**

 
 
• Kunchu Kurup is a renowned Kathakali dancer who has contributed significantly to the development and popularization of the dance form.
 
• Kathakali uses minimal props in the recital however it uses elaborate facial makes with different colors and headgear for a different character.
 
• The different facial color used in Kathakali has its own significance as following
 
 
• Green-It represents royalty, divinity, and virtue.
 
• Red patches beside noses- It represent royalty.
 
• Black-Its used for evil and wickedness.
 
• Yellow for saints and women.
 
• A completely red-painted face indicates evil.
 
• White beard-It represents being with higher consciousness and divinity.
 
 
 
• Kathakali is an all-male troupe performance.
 
• Kathakali is a temple dance
